column1: # Every call of libm 0.2.16's `pow` in crates/, its base and exponent ranges as the code bounds them, read site by site at 230742e on 2026-11-24 (plans/18 Ф28.J). pow gets this domain check, not an H-libm constant.
# Region R, read in libm-0.2.16/src/math/pow.rs:226-262, where pow approximates log x by a short series and is 635 ulp off at a published input (Gladman et al., August 2026, Table 7):
#   the short log series (pow.rs:256-262) runs iff 0x41e00000 < hi(|y|) <= 0x43f00000 (pow.rs:227, :229) AND 0x3fefffff <= hi(|x|) <= 0x3ff00000 (pow.rs:241, :248).

#   Excluded earlier: y = 0 (pow.rs:105), x = +1 (:110), NaN (:115-121), x = -1/0/inf (:190-210); x < 0 with non-integer y -> NaN (:213-218). |y| = 2^31 exactly (hi = 0x41e00000) takes the normal path.
#   For hi(|y|) > 0x43f00000 pow returns over/underflow (:229-238) without the series; for |x| outside the band it returns over/underflow (:240-254).
# Verdict: out = cannot enter R (reason given); open = R not excluded by the code. 'public API' = the exponent also comes from any external caller.
